reportedFailure: An investigator stopped with the legacy child-agent usage limit after four tool calls and 57024 reported cumulative tokens.
cause: Normal tools were available, but actual SRE workers still used legacy per-child/per-turn cumulative quotas, 32 tool calls, 34 model rounds, reduced context/output settings and an investigation deadline. Typed verifiers were also restricted to summarizing a fixed sample.
changes: SRE child journals retain actual usage accounting, but no longer enforce legacy Scout/Beacon per-child or per-turn quotas. Durable SRE task reservations remain enforced.

Operational specialists inherit the parent's model context, output ceiling, preferences and maxSteps; normal context maintenance and external cancellation remain available. No SRE sampler call cap or fixed ten-minute role deadline remains.

Separate task-wide cumulative usage from the single-request context window using a recorded parent-loop-v1 allocation: creation-time contextWindow times maxSteps. Continuing a task does not reset its usage or renew the new-policy allocation.
Continuing an old default-budget task upgrades that default policy without resetting spent usage. Explicit non-default allocations remain unchanged.
All operational roles receive recorded task facts as untrusted handoff context. Pure plan serialization and report-format repair remain tool-free stages.

Verifiers run their normal tool loop with or without fixed automatic criteria. Runtime acceptance probes are then collected after the review; only the exact returned runtime-owned evidence IDs count toward automatic checks. Extra observations cannot satisfy or multiply frozen samples.

regressions.verifier: Actual independent status and file reads in three cases: passed fixed criterion, failed fixed criterion, and no automatic probe. Fixed criteria count one designated sample despite additional independent observations. No-probe review stays inconclusive.
regressions.budgetAccounting: SRE accounting can exceed legacy child and turn caps, settles actual usage, and preserves cancellation. Existing legacy limits remain covered by their original tests.
regressions.boundaryChecks: Parent permission intersection, actual operation approvals, resource isolation, no replay of unknown dispatches, fresh independent verification and disabled ordinary-mode delegation remain covered.

diagnosedPausedTask.policy: legacy default; upgraded only on explicit continuation; not restarted during development

checks.devReload: passed after idle check; eight existing snapshots healthy
